warning_texts: The claims machine gate has no rule that checks caveat text for unsupported assertions: caveats_declared only requires listed topics to appear, so any extra caveat, including one carrying a number, passes silently; this auditor is the only check on that surface.

CLM-REFUND-RATE counts a customer as refunded if any delivered in-period order has refund_amount > 0, including partial refunds (for example 13.08 on a 26.15 order); the caveats state the paying-customer denominator but not that partial refunds count, and a reader may read 47.4% as customers fully r

On the order-row basis the same population gives 33/174 = 0.189655, so the paying-customer ruling roughly multiplies the headline refund figure by 2.5; any release text must keep the basis next to the number.

The period is 2025-01-01..2025-03-30 per audit_spec.yaml while metrics names it 2025-Q1 and questions.md calls it the reported quarter; the export has 0 rows dated 2025-03-31, so no figure changes, but the label is slightly wider than the population.

metrics/calculated_metrics.json writes the country formula as SUM(net_amount) WHERE country = country, which is a tautology as text; the values are correct, but the definition should name the country explicitly.
summary: All five published claim values reproduce exactly from raw_data/orders.csv (net 35741.52; refund rate 27/57 = 0.473684 on paying customers; PL 11181.67, DE 11032.61, CZ 13527.24, summing to the headline), and the machine gate's independent recalc is rooted in raw only. One blocker: CLM-NET-REVENUE carries a caveat asserting a quarter-over-quarter growth percentage that has no comparison base in the data (0 rows before 2025-01-01), no metric and no claim binding, so it is an unsupported trend claim and an unregistered business number; worker_analysis must remove it.
